summary: Vaxart, Inc. filed an 8-K under Item 8.01 solely to disclose a routine reorganization of its board committees. On July 27, 2026, the Board approved new appointments and chairs for the Nominating and Governance Committee (Kevin P. Finney as chair) and the Compensation Committee (James B. Breitmeyer, M.D., Ph.D. as chair), effective August 1, 2026. No financial terms, transaction details, or special-situation elements are present. This is an ordinary governance disclosure with no deal structure, consideration, or event affecting shareholders economically. No special-situation classification applies.
